DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 犬のリードの留め具が外れました。手元で押さえていますが、どこで待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: リードの留め具が外れ犬を手元で保持中なので待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The clasp on my dog's leash has come undone. I am holding the dog close to me, but where can I wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the leash clasp has come undone and you are holding the dog, and ask where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 犬を離さず、ほかの人の通路を空けてください。交換できるリードはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep hold of the dog and leave other people's path clear. Do you have a replacement leash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予備は家にあります。家族が近くにいるので届けてもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅の予備を近くの家族に届けてもらえると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a spare at home. My family is nearby and can bring it to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a family member nearby can bring the spare from home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま散歩を続けず、交換品を待つ場所を確認しましょう。犬は今落ち着いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than continuing the walk as it is, let us find somewhere to wait for the replacement. Is your dog calm now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 落ち着いています。遊具側は子どもが多いので、そこへは行きたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 犬は落ち着いているが子どもの多い遊具側を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the dog is calm. There are many children near the play equipment, so I do not want to go there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the dog is calm but you want to avoid the play equipment area with many children.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の位置から近い休憩スペースを示します。ほかの利用者との距離を保てる範囲で待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show you a rest area near your current location. Please wait where you can keep some distance from other visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に休憩スペースの場所を送ります。壊れた留め具を結んで散歩を続けるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ待機場所を送り壊れた留め具を仮に結んで散歩を続けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will send my family the rest area's location. I will not tie the broken clasp temporarily and continue the walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will send your family the waiting location and will not continue walking with the broken clasp temporarily tied.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 交換後も接続を確かめてください。交換が難しい場合は帰る方法を家族と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the connection after replacing it too. If replacement is difficult, discuss with your family how to get home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予備が届くまで犬を離さず待ちます。交換を確認したら今日は散歩を終え、家族と帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予備到着まで犬を保持し交換確認後は家族と帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait without letting go of the dog until the spare arrives. Once I have checked the replacement, I will end today's walk and go home with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will hold the dog until the spare arrives and go home with your family after checking the replacement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。待機場所へ案内します。周囲にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you the waiting area. Please watch your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約した新幹線の乗り場が見つかりません。この駅で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約した新幹線の乗り場がないため駅が合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find the platform for the Shinkansen I booked. Am I at the right station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you are at the right station because you cannot find the platform for your booked Shinkansen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票の出発駅を最後まで読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you read the departure station on your reservation slip all the way to the end?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白石蔵王とあります。「白石」だけ見て、ここへ来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発駅が白石蔵王で白石の部分だけ見て来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says Shiroishi-Zao. I only looked at the Shiroishi part and came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the departure station is Shiroishi-Zao and you came after reading only Shiroishi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 白石駅と白石蔵王駅は別です。予約の時刻まで、どのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Shiroishi Station and Shiroishi-Zao Station are different. How much time is there before your booked departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あと一時間です。ここで同じ列車を待たず、予約の駅へ移動したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発まで一時間あり別駅への移動を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: One hour. I would like to move to the station on my booking rather than wait for the same train here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that there is one hour until departure and you want to move to the other station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在地からの移動方法を案内所で確認しましょう。新幹線がここへ来るわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check at the information office how to travel from here. The Shinkansen will not come to this station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗換えのホームを探すのでなく、別の駅へ向かうということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同駅内のホーム移動でなく別駅へ行くことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I need to go to a different station rather than look for a transfer platform here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that this means going to another station rather than moving platforms within the same station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。移動の所要時間と到着の見込みを確認してから判断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please decide after checking the journey time and expected arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名を省略せず、白石蔵王までの移動を相談します。時刻に間に合うかも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅名を全部伝え所要時間と予約時刻に間に合うか相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the full station name and ask how to travel to Shiroishi-Zao. I will also check whether I can make the booked departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will give the full station name and ask about travel time and whether you can make the reservation time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内所はこちらです。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The information office is here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この収集表の「第二火曜日」は、毎週火曜日という意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 第二火曜日の表示が毎週火曜日か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does second Tuesday on this collection schedule mean every Tuesday?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the second Tuesday label means every Tuesday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の表では、その月の二回目の火曜日です。毎週ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this learning schedule, it means the second Tuesday of that month. It is not every week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二種類目のごみを火曜日に出すと思っていました。今月の日付を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ごみ種類の番号と誤解したと説明し今月日付を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it meant putting out the second type of rubbish on Tuesdays. I would like to check this month's date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook it for the rubbish category number and want to check this month's date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この練習用カレンダーで、一回目の火曜日から順に数えてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us count from the first Tuesday on this practice calendar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一回目は三日で、二回目は十日ですね。十日に印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カレンダーで三日と十日を数え第二火曜の十日に印を付けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The first is the third, and the second is the tenth. I will mark the tenth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Count the third and tenth on the calendar and answer in Japanese that you will mark the tenth as the second Tuesday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その数え方です。お住まいの区域の表かどうかも、表題を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is how to count it. Please also check the title to make sure it is the schedule for the area where you live.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の区域名が書いてあります。別の区域の表は使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表が自分の区域で別区域表を使わないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My area's name is written here. I will make sure not to use another area's schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the schedule is for your area and you will not use one for another area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。休日などによる変更は、その表の注意欄を読んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please read the notes on that schedule for changes due to holidays or other reasons.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 区域名と注意欄を確認し、毎週でなく二回目の火曜日として予定を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区域と注意欄を確認し収集予定を月の二回目へ訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the area name and notes and correct my plans to the second Tuesday rather than every Tuesday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the area and notes and correct the collection plan to the second occurrence in the month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: わかりました。実際に出す前にも最新の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the latest guidance again before actually putting out the rubbish.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 問診票を書き終わりました。記入した机へ置いてきましたが、そこへ出せばよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入済み問診票を机へ残したと説明し提出場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have finished filling in the medical questionnaire. I left it on the desk where I wrote it. Is that where I should submit it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you left the completed medical questionnaire on the desk and ask where to submit it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あの机は記入用です。書類はこちらの受付へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That desk is for writing. Please bring the documents to reception here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 提出する場所だと思って置きました。名前や症状を書いた面が上になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出場所と誤解し個人情報記入面を上に置いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I left it there because I thought that was the submission place. The side with my name and symptoms is facing up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook it for the submission place and left the side containing personal information facing up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの方の書類と混ざらないよう、ご自身の用紙を確認してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check and bring your own sheet so it is not mixed up with other people's documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の名前を確認し、書いた面を伏せて持ってきます。机にあるほかの紙は触りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の用紙だけ確認して記入面を伏せて持参すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check my name and bring it with the written side face down. I will not touch any other papers on the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will check only your own sheet and bring it with the completed side face down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。診察券と一緒に、こちらの職員へ直接お渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please hand it directly to the staff member here together with your patient card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の用紙を持ってきました。診察券はこちらです。二枚のうち、裏面も書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回収済み用紙と診察券を渡し裏面にも記入したと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have brought my own sheet. Here is my patient card. Of the two sheets, I have also written on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over the collected questionnaire and patient card and explain in Japanese that you wrote on the back too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりします。両面を確認して診療担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will take them. We will check both sides and hand them to the clinical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。次からは共用の机に残さず、書き終えた用紙を受付へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今後は共用台へ放置せず受付に直接提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. From next time, I will hand the completed form to reception instead of leaving it on the shared desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that in future you will submit directly to reception rather than leave the paper on the shared desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで受け取りました。番号をお呼びするまでお待ちください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received it here. Please wait until your number is called. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵を拾ったので届けに来ました。前に自分の鍵をなくしましたが、今日は拾った物の相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日の相談は拾得鍵の届けで過去の自分の紛失とは別だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a key and came to hand it in. I lost my own key before, but today I am asking about the one I found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that today's matter is handing in a found key, separate from the earlier loss of your own key.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は拾得物のお届けですね。どこで拾いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So today you are handing in found property. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園のベンチの横です。自分の鍵と似ていますが、同じ物だとはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公園ベンチ横で拾い自分の鍵と似るが同一不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside a bench in the park. It resembles my own key, but I do not know whether it is the same one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you found it beside a park bench and it resembles your key, but you do not know whether it is the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 似ているだけでご自身の物と決めず、拾った状況を伺います。何時ごろでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than deciding it is yours just because it looks similar, we will ask about how you found it. About what time was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝九時ごろです。赤い輪が付いた鍵一本で、袋には入っていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 九時ごろ拾った赤い輪付き鍵一本の状態を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around nine this morning. It was one key with a red ring, and it was not in a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese the condition of the one key with a red ring that you found around nine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状態を記録します。使って何の鍵か試したりはしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record that condition. You have not tried using it to see what it opens, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使っていません。落ちていたままの状態で持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵を試用せず拾った状態で持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not used it. I brought it just as it was when I found it on the ground.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you did not try the key and brought it as found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。ご自身の以前の紛失相談は、別に確認する必要があれば担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. If your earlier lost-key report needs checking separately, please tell the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は拾った場所と状態を届け、持ち主の確認は担当にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得場所と状態を届け持ち主確認を担当へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will report where I found it and its condition, and leave checking the owner to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will report the finding location and condition and ask the person in charge to check the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらでお預かりして手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will take it here and explain the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 返品用のラベルを印刷しましたが、コードが黒くつぶれています。このまま荷物へ貼っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返品ラベルのコードが印刷で黒く潰れ貼付可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I printed a return label, but its code is blurred into solid black. May I stick it on the parcel as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the printed return label's code has become solid black and ask whether you can attach it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ受付前ですね。販売元から受け取ったラベルでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It has not been accepted yet, correct? Is this a label you received from the seller?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。画面では四角の細かい模様が見えましたが、印刷した紙では一部が真っ黒です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通販元データは細模様だが紙に黒潰れがあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. On the screen I could see the fine square pattern, but part of it is completely black on the printed paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the online seller's data shows a fine pattern, but the paper print has solid black areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: コードをペンで補わず、元のデータと印刷の状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the original data and print quality without filling in the code with a pen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛先の文字は読めます。コードだけ自分で描き直すのでなく、ラベルをもう一度用意したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所は可読だがコードを手描きせず新印刷を準備したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The address text is readable. Instead of drawing the code again myself, I would like to prepare the label again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the address is readable but you want a new print rather than drawing the code by hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返送方法の指定も販売元へ確認しましょう。住所だけで同じ受付になるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us also check the required return method with the seller. The address alone does not necessarily allow the same processing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返送の案内を保存してあります。再発行の依頼先へ、印刷がつぶれたと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存した返送案内で再発行先へ印刷不良を連絡すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have saved the return instructions. I will contact the reissue contact to tell them the print has become blurred and solid black.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will use the saved return instructions to contact the label reissue contact about the print problem.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しいラベルを用意してから、荷物と案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please prepare a new label, then bring the parcel and instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は発送せず持ち帰り、販売元のラベルを整えてから貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日発送せず持帰り指定ラベル修復後に貼付すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not send it today; I will take it home and attach the seller's label after getting it ready properly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese not to send today, to take it home, and to attach the required label after fixing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。印刷を直せましたらまたご相談ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult us again once you have corrected the print. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ出す口座のコピーを用意しましたが、裏に家族の口座まで印刷してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座コピー裏面に家族口座情報を誤印刷したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I prepared a copy of my bank account information for work, but I also printed my family's account on the back by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you accidentally printed a family member's account information on the back of your salary account copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このコピーをまだ職場へ渡していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you not given this copy to your workplace yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。自分の資料だけのつもりで、両面印刷に気づきませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場未提出で両面印刷を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I intended it to be only my own information and did not notice it was double-sided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not submitted it to work and overlooked the double-sided printing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず職場が求める本人の口座情報を確認しましょう。依頼の用紙はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let us check which account details about you your workplace requires. Do you have their request sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。銀行名、支店名、口座番号と名義です。家族の資料を見せる指定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場指定は本人銀行支店番号名義で家族資料不要と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The bank name, branch name, account number, and account holder name. It does not ask me to show my family's documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that work requests your own bank, branch, account number, and account holder name, without family documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の資料の必要な面を確認できます。提出先の条件に合わせてコピーを作り直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the required side of your own documents. Please remake the copy to match the submission destination's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏面をペンで消して出すのでなく、白い紙へ自分の情報だけ印刷し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 塗り潰しでなく白紙へ本人情報のみ再印刷すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Instead of blacking out the back with a pen and submitting it, I will reprint only my own information on blank paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will reprint only your own information on blank paper rather than blacking out the unwanted part.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。印刷後も裏面に何もないか、ご本人で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After printing, please also check for yourself that there is nothing on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な項目を照合してから片面の資料を作り、今の両面コピーは家族の情報ごと持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要項目照合と片面確認を行い既存家族情報コピーを持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will compare the required items and prepare a single-sided document, and take the current double-sided copy with my family's information home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will compare the required items, check single-sided printing, and take home the existing copy containing family information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料をお返しします。お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here are your documents back. Please take them home carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚から取るときに瓶を落として割ってしまいました。床に破片があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 商品瓶を取り落として割り床に破片があると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I dropped a bottle while taking it from the shelf, and it broke. There are fragments on the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you dropped and broke a product bottle and there are fragments on the floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 破片には触れないでください。お客様にけがはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not touch the fragments. Are you injured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: けがはありません。素手で拾おうとしましたが、まだ触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人無傷で素手回収未実行と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not injured. I was going to pick them up with my bare hands, but I have not touched them yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are uninjured and have not yet tried collecting them with bare hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで清掃します。ほかのお客様が近づかないよう、安全な位置からお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will clean it. Please warn other customers from a safe position so they do not come close.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 破片の所には入らず、通る人に足元へ近づかないよう声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安全位置から通行者へ破片への接近注意を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will stay out of the area with fragments and tell people passing not to step near them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will warn passersby from a safe position not to approach the fragments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私物が近くにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Are any of your belongings nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買物袋を横に置きました。破片がある場所を通らないと取れないので、今はそのままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私物袋は破片の先なので今は回収しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put my shopping bag beside it. I would have to cross the area with fragments to get it, so I will leave it there for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your personal bag is beyond the fragments and you will not retrieve it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 清掃後に袋の場所も一緒に確認します。商品の扱いは担当から説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: After cleaning, we will check the bag's location together too. The person in charge will explain how the product will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋を無理に取りに行かず待ちます。割った商品のことも、逃げずに担当へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 清掃を待ち商品の扱いも担当へ説明を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait instead of forcing my way to the bag. I will also stay and explain to the person in charge about the product I broke rather than leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wait for cleaning and discuss the handling of the product with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせくださりありがとうございます。清掃が終わるまでこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us. Please wait here until cleaning is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園清掃の二番に来たのですが、駐車場の二区画で待てばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃の二番が駐車場二区画集合か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came for number two of the park cleanup. Should I wait in parking section two?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether number two for the cleanup means meeting in parking section two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用案内の二番は、活動班の番号です。駐車区画ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Number two in this learning guide is the activity team's number. It is not a parking section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 班の番号だったのですね。初参加で、集合場所を読み違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 活動班の番号と理解し初参加で集合を読み違えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was the team number. It is my first time participating, and I misread the meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand it is the activity team number and misread the meeting details because this is your first time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二班の集合は、この案内図の受付前です。作業場所は受付で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Team two meets in front of reception on this guide map. We will explain the work location at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付へ行ってから、担当者と作業場所へ移動するのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付後に担当と作業場所へ行く理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I go to reception first, then move to the work location with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese your understanding that you go to the work location with the person in charge after reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。集合の段階で、ご自身だけで作業区域へ入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please do not go into the work area by yourself at the gathering stage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道具は持ってきていません。二班の受付で貸出しについて聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具未持参なので二班受付で貸出しを尋ねられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not brought tools. Can I ask about borrowing them at team two's reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can ask about tool loans at team two's reception because you did not bring tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 聞けます。参加名簿と担当の案内を確認してから、準備を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us check the participant list and the person in charge's instructions before preparing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駐車区画では待たず受付前へ行き、二班の参加者だと伝えて準備を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駐車区画でなく受付前へ行き二班参加と準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go to the front of reception instead of waiting in the parking section, say I am a team two participant, and ask about preparations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will go to reception rather than the parking section and discuss being in team two and preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付はこちらです。ご参加ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Reception is here. Thank you for participating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と子どもの切符を買いたいです。この二人というボタンで、子どもの分も一緒になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人と子供の券を大人人数二人ボタンで買えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy tickets for myself and my child. Will this two-person button include my child's ticket too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can buy your own and your child's tickets with the two-adult passenger button.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面の人数ボタンは大人の欄です。お子様の年齢を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The passenger buttons on this screen are in the adult section. Please tell me your child's age.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 八歳です。人数を二人にすれば区分も自動で変わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子供八歳で人数だけ変えれば区分も変わると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Eight. I thought changing the passenger count to two would automatically change the categories too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your child is eight and you thought changing only the passenger count would change the categories too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 年齢とご利用条件を確認して、区分ごとに選びましょう。もう支払いはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the age and travel conditions and select each category separately. Have you already paid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。大人二人と出たので、確定せずに相談しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大人二人表示で気づき決済未確定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. It displayed two adults, so I asked for advice without confirming it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noticed the two-adult display and have not confirmed payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、今の選択を戻して大人一人の欄から確認しましょう。お子様の区分はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us undo the current selection and check from the one-adult field. Your child's category is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大人一人と子ども一人になりました。同じ行先であることも二枚とも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大人一人子供一人への修正と両券行先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It now shows one adult and one child. I will also check that both tickets have the same destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the correction to one adult and one child and the destination on both tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。画面の区分、人数、行先を確認してから購入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the categories, number of passengers, and destination on the screen before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人という数だけで選ばず、それぞれの区分と行先を確認して支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数のみでなく区分人数行先を照合後に支払うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not choose based only on the number two. I will check each category and destination before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will compare the categories, passenger counts, and destination rather than just the number of people before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。券が出た後も二枚をご確認ください。お子様とよいお出かけを。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check both tickets after they come out too. Enjoy your outing with your child.
